name: DSB Electronics 12V Mini UPS for WiFi Router
shortDescription: 12V mini UPS power bank that keeps your WiFi router running during load shedding.
description: A 12-volt mini UPS from DSB Electronics that backs up your WiFi router during power outages. The packaging advertises long battery life, overcharge protection and 9–12 hours of backup.

specifications.label: Backup time
specifications.value: 9–12 hours (as advertised on packaging; depends on router)
